name: Host-Control Binding Observability Audit v1
question: Does Role-level aggregation discard observable heterogeneous control-to-Host bindings, with sufficient strict within-APK randomization coverage to justify specifying a separate information test?
scope: read-only reuse of all 799 passed LCC incremental scans and frozen C43 Hosts; primary coverage on the unchanged 200 SVM MeanOpposition routed APKs
proof_definition: inherit the four edge-level flags from the previous incremental feature_core: any verified, all observed verified, any dominating no-bypass proof, any bypass among verified
unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN and PARTIAL never imply unguarded, benign or malicious; missing pairs remain missing
host_context: frozen C43 SelfRole31 and Tail12, plus Relation31. SelfRole and Relation are retained; Tail12 is bounded by x/(1+abs(x)) for numerical comparability in the audit only. No trained background, attention or hidden embeddings are substituted.
joint_descriptor: per-Role covariance of four proof flags with 74 Host coordinates, averaged over observed frozen Host-endpoint pairs. This is an audit descriptor, NOT a chosen classifier feature or proof that full C43 loses information.
null_definition: within each APK, permute whole four-flag bundles among observed pairs having the EXACT same Role set, observed event count, and UNKNOWN event count, and different Host IDs; preserve original graphs, traces and all receiver coverage metadata
null_algorithm: for each exact stratum, randomize lists within each Host, take one pair from every remaining Host, rotate donors by a nonzero offset, and repeat while at least two Hosts remain. Unmatched residual pairs stay fixed. No fabricated mobility or label-driven matching relaxation.
gate_interpretation: Pre-frozen engineering readiness criteria, not statistical significance, classifier quality or benign/malware evidence.
on_pass: HOST_CONTROL_BINDING_OBSERVABLE: permit specifying a separate source-only information test; do not run it in this package
on_fail: HOST_CONTROL_BINDING_COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT: stop this version without changing matching or thresholds
prohibited: exact API identity in joint descriptor
claim_boundary: Synthetic reassignment of annotations is not an executable APK intervention, semantic equivalence or runtime causality. Observability does not establish independent class information, error causation, compression as the dominant bottleneck, or a new deployable model. Prior source results have already been inspected.
